stories.headline: UK and Norway agree on AI cooperation
stories.summary: The UK and Norway signed a joint statement to deepen cooperation on AI research, compute, defense, safety, and governance.
stories.why_it_matters: Signals cross-border policy alignment on advanced AI.

stories.headline: UKRI names 20 new Turing AI Fellows
stories.summary: UK Research and Innovation announced 20 Turing AI Fellows backed by more than £39 million to strengthen UK AI capability.
stories.why_it_matters: Major public funding for AI talent and research capacity.

stories.headline: Berkeley joins Schmidt Science Computing Network
stories.summary: UC Berkeley and Berkeley Lab will add the Berkeley Science AI Platform to expand high-performance computing for scientific discovery.
stories.why_it_matters: New compute can accelerate AI-driven research across disciplines.
